name: Guang Fan Zhi Di
source:
This game tells the story of a high school student named Carters ("Player") who, due to the premature death of his parents, has no other family members to take care of and has to bear all the responsibilities of the family. Although life was very tense and difficult, he still had his own brother Kasvi accompanying him along the way. But slipping under Carters's sight, Kasvi was suffering inhumane torture and pain.

[Edited from [url=https://kieost.itch.io/relight-the-land]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该游戏讲述了一位名叫卡特斯（“玩家”）的高中生，由于父母早逝，没有其他家庭成员需要照顾，不得不承担家庭的所有责任。尽管生活非常紧张和困难，但他一路上还有自己的弟弟卡斯维陪伴。但卡斯维却在卡特的视线中溜走，遭受着非人的折磨和痛苦。

[编辑自[url=https://kieost.itch.io/relight-the-land]Itch.io[/url]]
